name: Mikoshiba Shuri
source:
Subject: Japanese History

The teacher in charge of history.
Born into a wealthy family, she was raised with a gifted education and excelled in many subjects.
She was aware of her many fortunes, and while proud of her abilities, she became a teacher because she wanted to use her abilities to help others.
'You act like there is nothing you can't do' is her catchphrase which she says without any sarcasm. It's the type of innocence that comes from growing up as a daughter of a wealthy family and having no distractions in life. Despite this, she is well-respected, and isn't disliked for her insolence.

A serious teacher, she is enthusiastic about educating her students.
Because of her high confidence, she has plenty of pride.
